sources.label: My Morphe patches; mainly focused on financial and productivity/utility apps
sources.author: Aidan
patch_list: Replaces the unavailable store with a dialog to view and set your exact chip balance.
Removes banner, interstitial, and rewarded advertising and removes ad-based chip offers.
Removes Internet permissions from AndroidManifest.xml to prevent network access.
Removes notification permissions from AndroidManifest.xml to eliminate push notifications entirely.
Neutralizes active advertising telemetry, analytics, attribution, and crash reporting.
Allows tapping the next level indicator on the top bar to show a confirmation dialog and skip to the next level. REQUIRES Add Custom Chip Store to be enabled.
